title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier W/ Towel Bar | Glokzin Teal | Wall-Mounted Solid Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Need more bathroom storage without giving up counter space? This wall-mounted glass shelf (also called a bathroom shelf or wall shelf) adds three levels of storage plus an integrated towel bar for towels right where you need them in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms. Designed for traditional bathroom hardware settings, it pairs the clarity of tempered, beveled-edged glass with solid brass hardware for enduring support and a refined look.

Highlights:
- Glokzin Teal transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
• Keep towels accessible with the integrated towel bar (towel bar / towel holder)
• Create a clean installation with concealed screw mounting hardware
• Complements classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures in traditional spaces

Specs & Installation:
• Product type: glass shelf / bathroom shelf / wall shelf
• Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
• Overall dimensions: 16 in (L) x 18 in (H) x 5 in (W)
• Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 in)
• Weight capacity: 6 lb
• Material: solid brass hardware (brass construction)
• Mounting: wall mount, wall-mounted, wall hanging
• Assembly required: No
• Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware
• Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
• Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
